notes.title: Zombie Groove Update Event! Win 500$ KPOP Goodies!
notes.content:
You're a fan of KPOP and you can't find any game that matches your tastes?
Zombie Groove's got you! Who said you have to use violence to get rid of Zombies?
The power of KPOP can destroy them all if you have the rhythm in you!
Join our Zombie Groove Release Events and win a fantastic prize!🤑


🔴[h1]Event 1: Lucky Draw Screenshot Event[/h1]
1. Take a Screenshot of your Best Moment on Zombie Groove
2. Share it on Facebook, Twitter, or Instagram with #ZombieGroove
🤑Prize: 1 Lucky Draw Winner - 250$ of KPOP Goodies or 250$ Steam Wallet
[hr][/hr]


🔴[h1]Event 2: Best Score Video Event[/h1]
All you have to do is train hard and record your best score
on the new title of Red Velvet "Pink Venom" in Zombie Groove!
1. Record a video of your Gameplay with the Best Score on the song Pink Venom
2. Share it on Youtube, Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok, or Twitter with #ZombieGroove and your Steam Name!

🤑Prize: 1 Best Score Winner - 250$ of KPOP Goodies or 250$ Steam Wallet
[hr][/hr]

📆Participate in the events from 14.11 until 27.11 23.59 CEST
* Make sure it is set as Public
* Make sure you can receive DMs in Case you are the winner!
* When KPOP Goodies are not available in your country to deliver, you will earn 250$ Steam Wallet.

🎶Song: Pink Venom
🎶Artist: Black Pink
🎶Check out our latest videos!
